rationale: The only implementation delta is the RLE compact-pixel allocation size: the fixed version allocates one additional element with `(2*channels*next_image->columns)+1`, while the vulnerable version omits it. The Logic section merely states that memory is allocated for pixel data and later managed, without specifying the allocation bound, extra-element guard, or any vulnerable under-allocation behavior. Its claims about compression, color-space/channel handling, progress reporting, and memory release hold across both versions.
